name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
accessNote: Underground dungeon south of Dorgesh-Kaan, near fairy ring AJQ. Entry requires completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun and a rope to climb down; a light source is required. Home to Molanisks, which disguise on the cave walls and must be lured off with a Slayer bell. A Dwarf multicannon can be used and certain rocks (notably the large rock south of the AJQ fairy ring) provide safespots. Multi is not wiki-confirmed (conservative default).
